# sherpa-nav-item

A single navigation row. Figma "Navigation Item" (32:43138).

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | nav |
| Built on | the native `<button>`, which gives click, keyboard, focus, disabled |
| Templates | `default`, `promo` |
| Figma | Navigation Item |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-nav-item/sherpa-nav-item.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-nav-item/sherpa-nav-item.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-nav-item/sherpa-nav-item.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-nav-item/sherpa-nav-item.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-nav-item/sherpa-nav-item.example.json) |

## When to use it

For one row in a nav you build by hand; `sherpa-nav` makes its own rows. `data-href` makes the row a real link, and `data-expandable` makes it a parent row that toggles and never navigates.

## Example

```html
<sherpa-nav-item data-icon="home" data-label="Home" data-href="?context=home" data-badge="3"></sherpa-nav-item>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-badge` | text |  | the trailing Tag's text (Figma hasTag) |
| `data-current` | boolean |  | current item in the nav set |
| `data-description` | text |  | promo description (promo variant only) |
| `data-expandable` | boolean |  | the item has children — shows the chevron (Figma hasChildren) |
| `data-expanded` | boolean |  | expanded state — rotates the chevron |
| `data-href` | text |  | render the row as a link |
| `data-icon` | text |  | leading icon — an icon name ("home"); any other value renders as a literal text glyph |
| `data-label` | text |  | row label text |
| `data-status-dot` | boolean |  | render the trailing Indicator (atom) dot |
| `data-tier` | `2` `3` |  | nesting depth 2 \| 3 — indents the row to the Figma indent tier (tier 1 is the default, no attribute needed) |
| `data-type` | text |  | "promo" for the CTA row |
| `disabled` | boolean, native | `false` | disabled state |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Access | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `current` | `boolean` | read and write | reads and toggles data-current |
| `expanded` | `boolean` | read and write | reads and toggles data-expanded |

## Methods

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| `highlight(query: string \| null)` | Mark a substring of this row's label as a search match. Null/empty clears it. |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail | What it means |
|---|---|---|
| `item-select` | `{ href: null \| string; label: string }` |  |
| `item-expand` | `{ expanded: boolean }` | The chevron was clicked |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `trailing` | control, badge |  |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`badge`, `chevron`, `content`, `description`, `dot`, `expand`, `heading`, `icon`, `label`, `row`
